**Date:** 14 October 2024, when the failure was officially confirmed.

**Named person:** Dr. Marek Oslavin, Chief Agronomist, Tavrin Valley Agricultural Board.

**Figure:** Sugar beet yields fell 62% below the five-year average, with about 18,400 hectares affected.

**Source document:** The Board's "Autumn Harvest Assessment Report (TVAB-24/09)", released at a press briefing in the town of Karsholm.
